summary: {person} arrives at a closed facility that the public map still lists as available.
realLife: Seattle auditors found five restrooms closed among fifty independent site visits even though the city dashboard listed those five as open.
gates: A dated status listing and a visit to the same facility.
weights: A recent closure increases the chance that a periodic map update lags.
inGame: needs: facility ID, dashboard update time, observed door status and visit time.

turns.what: The map editor changes the public listing.
turns.pulledBy: The site manager confirms the closure.
turns.writesBack: Record when the correction went live.

turns.what: The editor checks the interval the map missed.
turns.pulledBy: The building has reopened since the visit.
turns.writesBack: Retain the closure and reopening timestamps.
